output_evals.prompt: Mam akcje PKO BP. Czy Pekao jest teraz relatywnie tańsze i czy warto się przesiąść?
assertions: scripts/gpw_pair_trading.py switch PKOBP PEKAO was executed
Answer in Polish leads with the switch.verdict and today's z-score
Answer states whether the pair is cointegrated (p-value) and does not treat a non-cointegrated z-score as a reason to expect reversion
Answer mentions the switch cost and the 19% Belka tax on a gain in a regular account (none in IKE/IKZE)
No phrase like 'kup Pekao' or 'sprzedaj PKO'

output_evals.prompt: Which Polish bank pairs are cointegrated right now?
assertions: scripts/gpw_pair_trading.py scan --sector banks --lang en was executed
Answer reports the number of pairs tested and how many pass after the Benjamini-Hochberg correction
If no pair passes, the answer says so plainly instead of listing raw p-values below 0.05 as discoveries
Answer explains why a multiple-testing correction is needed

output_evals.prompt: Przeanalizuj parę PKOBP i PEKAO — kointegracja, półokres, stabilność, test historyczny.
assertions: scripts/gpw_pair_trading.py pair PKOBP PEKAO was executed
Answer quotes hedge_ratio, p_value, half_life_days, stability and hedge-ratio drift from the JSON
Backtest results are labelled illustrative, with the short-leg availability and borrow cost described as assumptions
Answer explains that single-stock short selling is hard on GPW and mentions the stock futures availability reported by the script

output_evals.prompt: Czy są jakieś sygnały dyslokacji par w paliwach i energetyce?
assertions: Answer lists every item of signals[] (cheap leg, pair, date, z) or says there are none
Signals are described as long the cheap leg relative to its pair, never as a short recommendation
